purpose: Test whether native-resolution iNaturalist image retrieval materially changes the current detector-plus-27-endpoint image-feature pipeline before any decision to scale native-resolution processing. This gate does not require permanent storage of source images.

source.source_scope: Frozen July 2026 merged metadata snapshot; technical pilot only, not a representative ecological cohort.

sampling.rule: From the immutable source row order, consider the first rights-usable photo encountered for each observation, then retain the 32 lowest SHA-256 scores of salt|obs_id|photo_id. No trait, taxon, geography, environment or result is used for selection.

image_versions.url_rule: Replace the explicit iNaturalist size path component while preserving file extension and query string.
image_versions.retention: Download one medium/original pair at a time into memory, decode with EXIF display orientation, record byte hashes/dimensions/numerical outputs, then release the bytes. Do not upload or commit source-image bytes.

matching.assignment: greedy descending IoU with one-to-one detection matching

endpoint_gate.insufficient_rule: Endpoints below the common-usable minimum remain INSUFFICIENT_COMMON_USABLE and cannot trigger a full-source original-retention requirement.
endpoint_gate.promotion_rule: A flag justifies a larger streamed native-resolution test for that endpoint. It does not justify permanent retention of every original image.

outputs.private_manifest: pilot_manifest_private.csv; IDs and URLs exist only on the ephemeral runner and are deleted before artifact upload
outputs.pair_receipt: pair_transfer_and_detection.csv; anonymous pair IDs, byte hashes, dimensions, detector counts and failures, no image bytes or source IDs
outputs.measurements: matched_endpoint_measurements.csv; anonymous pair IDs plus medium/original numerical endpoint values and QC states
outputs.report: resolution_gate_report.json; aggregate endpoint status and peak live source-byte footprint

claim_boundary: This pilot measures total pipeline sensitivity to server image version, not physical botanical accuracy.
Differences can arise from server resizing/JPEG encoding, detector localization, segmentation or feature extraction.
The 32-photo deterministic pilot is a technical screen, not an ecological sample.
No result from this gate establishes adaptation, phenotype accuracy, or a need to archive approximately 1.5 TB of originals.
